system.description:
MARTIAL

You have devoted yourself to the path of the Zen Archer, honing your skills in both martial arts and archery.

Prerequisites Inner Discipline, Mental Focus 1 rank

You gain proficiency with the longbow, shortbow and all composite bows. You also gain the Perfect Shot feat.

Finally, any ability that may be used with unarmed strikes (such as flurry of blows) may also be used with a bow weapon.

Progression Requirements Mental Focus skill +10 ranks

Be aware that a Zen Archer may also select feats available to the archer archetype.

Automated: you are proficient with the longbow, short bow and composite bows, and you gain Perfect Shot. Flurry of Blows and every other ability used with unarmed strikes may be used with a bow (not a crossbow); an ability that needs a melee attack still needs one (Graham's B7-6). You count as having the Archer archetype for class feats with the Archer trait.

effects.name: Zen Archer: bows
effects.description: Proficient with the longbow, short bow and composite bows.
